label: TP
reason: User input flows through doSomething into bar via Base64 encode/decode (which does not neutralize SQL injection risks) and is directly concatenated into a SQL query string. The query uses unsafe string interpolation rather than parameterized queries, allowing attacker-controlled data to reach the database sink.

evidence.note: User input flows from getParameterMap() -> param -> doSomething() -> bar -> SQL query string
doSomething() performs redundant Base64 encode/decode that does not prevent SQL injection
Unsafe SQL string interpolation with user-derived bar variable
